_comment: CR section owners (CR audit tool 1.13). One entry per section (n.n) at the CR pin. `owner` is `area N` (1-16, the CR audit plan's areas), `fidelity` or `standardization` (the earlier programs, re-audited by RA-1 and RA-2), `reference` (definitions with no procedure of their own), or `none`. A split section names its other owners in `subrules`: a rule takes the owner of the listed subrule it is or sits under (8.5.1b is under 8.5.1; 8.5.10 is not), listed subrules never nest, and the section's `owner` takes the rest. `why` says where in docs/plans/cr-audit-standardization-program.md the owner comes from. tests/cr-section-owners.test.ts checks this file against vendor/cr-data/nodes.json.
